notes.title: v1.1.1: Vegetation and Shaders Update
notes.notes:
* Reflection removed from vegetation
* Vegetation variety increased / density tweaked
* Shaders adjusted to render a sharper image
* Brightness tweaked to avoid maps appearing too bright or too dark

notes.title: v1.1.0 Update Released
notes.notes:
Changelog:

* Contrast & brightness adjusted for clarity to render a less muddy image.
* Tank path-finding behavior improved.
* 'Revert to default' buttons on menu now only reverts the settings on the 
   currently selected tab.
* Hovercraft weapon rotation smoothed.

notes.title: Another Major Update Released
notes.notes: This update smooths the terrain to ensure it's easier to traverse while the physics issues with the hovercraft have been dealt with and the enemy behavior polished further.

notes.title: Major Update Available
notes.notes: This update brings revisions to the core game-play experience including improved level design, pacing and enemy behavior. A number of issues affecting the game have also been fixed.
